current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly it’s the sleep, really. I’ve been having trouble getting off to sleep for about seven months now, ever since my shift pattern changed, and then I’m tired through the day because of it. My mood’s been okay otherwise, more or less stable.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to sleep properly again, without having to rely on anything… that’s really the main thing.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Yes — CBT, cognitive behavioural therapy. I had it around 2010, about 12 sessions, at a community clinic.; Around 2010.; About 12 sessions.
